summary.headline: Jupiter in Planetary Terms
summary.text: Chapter XXI interprets Jupiter in its own terms and in Saturn’s terms, covering wealth, service, inheritance, enemies, head pain, marriage, children, negotiation, and the effects of benefic aspects and house placement. The preceding Saturn-in-Mercury’s-term judgment concerns lawsuits, infertility, children, social honor, royal adversaries, dispossession, and release through benefic aspects.
